ConcreteFinding.Reason: All use shared ProcessSpawnOptions either local wrapper or remote creator. Valid options are not invalid Erlang merely because runtime lacks their behavior.
ConcreteFinding.EvidenceLevel: Direct source proof; no fresh native or SDK execution.

ExistingHonestSupport: link priority-message option (not process scheduling priority)
monitor priority-message, custom tag and alias options
PriorityVsSignalPriority: ProcessSpawnOptions.PriorityLink/MonitorOptions.Priority control priority delivery of EXIT/DOWN, not process run-queue priority. No process-priority field is parsed.

ExistingRuntimeMechanism.Query: ProcessRuntime process_info priority returns that fixed field.
ExistingRuntimeMechanism.Flag: CoreModules process_flag/2 lacks process priority branch and rejects priority.
ExistingRuntimeMechanism.Dispatcher: One ConcurrentExclusiveSchedulerPair with fixed concurrency; Dispatch has no process/priority parameter.
ExistingRuntimeMechanism.ReductionYield: ChargeAsync slice2000 admits signals then Task.Yield; no owned priority runqueue admission.

RecommendedNext: Real local cooperative process-priority runqueues plus priority process_flag/query and shared spawn initialization. Do not merely accept/store values.
